scope: Conservative declared Windows desktop build inputs, including optional and other-platform dependencies; not a final installed-artifact inventory or legal/security clearance.
removedInputEvidence: The supported Node runtime supplies global.fetch, already preferred by both unchanged Tesseract 7 Node adapters. A version-scoped pnpm override removes the unused legacy fallback and its exclusive subtree; tests verify lock/resolution absence and English/French local HTTP image/model recognition. This removes one gap by eliminating that dependency, not by inventing or clearing its missing licence.
partialNpmNotices: desktop-npm-partial-notices.json retains seven exact Brotli decoder copyright headers plus full explicitly adopted Apache-2.0 steward terms. A bounded built-in Brotli decode and strict literal-only source parsing prove the compressed browser dictionary equals the explicitly licensed source table byte-for-byte; its derived-data notice is now retained too. No package code is executed. All records remain packageNoticeComplete false; wrapper/encoder/encoder-memory gaps stay open.
evidence: desktop-license-supplements.json binds every retained source supplement to exact crate archive/original manifest hashes and source commits. Source Cargo.toml comparisons were byte-identical except the two dlopen2 manifests, which differed only by CRLF/LF. Missing path_in_vcs in older rust-unic archives is not invented: explicit sourceManifestPath plus byte-identical source manifests bind those paths. This follow-up retains r-efi's full offered MIT branch and original attributions from its exact AUTHORS files, correcting the previous declaration-only assessment. selectors' explicit MPL-2.0 source header is bound to the steward's full versioned text and an exact unmodified-source availability notice.
branchPolicy: The recorded selectedLicense identifies an offered alternative, not a rewrite of upstream licensing or clearance of vendored/native/data dependencies. All original declarations, copyrights and third-party rights remain applicable. No generic text is generated or borrowed from an unrelated version.

remainingGroups.finding: Inspected pinned upstream licence overview links to standard licence sites and discusses Apple SDK implications, but does not include full licence texts. Do not count that overview as retained full terms.
remainingGroups.nextAction: Obtain attributable version-bound terms/copyright evidence and resolve any applicable SDK obligations, or prove absence from the final Windows artifact. Do not auto-clear these other-platform declared inputs.

remainingGroups.finding: cesu8 ships COPYRIGHT-RUST.txt and source headers referring to MIT/Apache terms, but no full project terms bound to its published archive/upstream revision. Other projects' MIT excerpts in that file are not substituted.
remainingGroups.nextAction: Bind full upstream terms to exact packaged source; retain applicable attribution and review any source-availability obligations. A permissive SPDX declaration or licence URL is not enough.

remainingGroups.finding: These cached packages lack cargo VCS metadata. No current-branch generic licence is substituted.
remainingGroups.nextAction: Establish reproducible exact-version source/archive binding before retaining upstream texts, or establish final-artifact absence.

remainingGroups.payloadEvidence: windows-npm-notice-review.json retains the four active payload-tree bindings and historical evidence for removed tr46. verify-windows-npm-notices.mjs rechecks active installed trees; --registry also verifies published bytes without extracting or executing package code. Scoped Brotli decoder terms and Fontkit inherited Base64 terms are now retained; neither is whole-package or native binary clearance.
remainingGroups.finding: Installed packages lack root notice text. Native Canvas includes a Skia binary and ICU data; an npm MIT declaration does not clear those components. The optional Node canvas is not imported by the browser/WebView frontend, but this inventory does not prove final-artifact absence. Direct inspection of brotli 1.3.3 dec/decode.js found Google Apache-2.0 copyright/header text despite the npm-level MIT declaration; a root MIT label alone cannot clear the vendored decoder.
remainingGroups.nextAction: Obtain missing authoritative project terms and remaining vendored Brotli/Skia/ICU provenance/attribution; preserve the retained partial decoder and inherited Base64 notices. Follow-up drafts reference existing upstream threads, but posting was refused by the GitHub integration. Final artifact scope still requires independent proof.
